`PrivacyNotice` renders `h1` ("Privacy notice") then, when a change note is present, an `h3` ("What changed", via `Callout headingLevel={3}`) before the `nav`'s `h2` ("Contents") — a skip from 1 to 3 with no intervening 2. Fix: change the change-note `Callout`'s `headingLevel` to `2`, matching the level of every other top-level section heading it sits beside. Owed to T559 (phase 5, the retrofit that empties this allowlist).

The `role="menu"` surface's DOM children are unstyled wrapper `<div>`s (`MenuItemRow`'s outer element, and the footer item's wrapping `<div>`) around each `role="menuitem"`/`role="menuitemradio"` button, so in the accessibility tree `menu`'s children are anonymous divs rather than menu items, which is exactly the ARIA-required-owned-elements violation FR-057 names. Fix: add `role="presentation"` to both wrapping `<div>`s so the menuitem roles sit directly under `menu`. Owed to T559 (phase 5, the retrofit that empties this allowlist).

Structural root cause is `StatValue`, not this component: `StatValue`'s `<dl>` renders `<dt>`/`<dd>` and then, when `secondaryLine` is set, a bare `<span>` as a third direct child — `<dl>` may only directly contain properly-ordered `dt`/`dd` groups, `script`, `template` or `div`, and a `<span>` sibling is none of those. `AnalysisTimeline` only inherits the defect by composing `StatValue` with a `secondaryLine`. Fix: move `secondaryLine` inside the `<dd>` (or wrap the trailing element in a `<div>`) in `StatValue`'s own markup — one fix closes this entry, favourites-list and stat-value together. Owed to T559 (phase 5, the retrofit that empties this allowlist).

Same root cause as analysis-timeline and stat-value: `StatValue`'s `<dl>` places `secondaryLine` as a bare `<span>` sibling of its `<dt>`/`<dd>` pair, which `<dl>`'s allowed-children rule rejects. `FavouritesList` only inherits the defect by composing `StatValue` with a `secondaryLine`. Fixed once, in `StatValue` itself. Owed to T559 (phase 5, the retrofit that empties this allowlist).

`StatValue`'s `<dl>` renders `<dt>` (the label) and `<dd>` (the value), then, when `secondaryLine` is set, a bare `<span>` as a third direct child of the `<dl>` — not an allowed direct child alongside a `dt`/`dd` group. Fix: move `secondaryLine` inside the `<dd>` (or wrap it in a `<div>`) in `packages/design-system/src/components/StatValue/index.tsx`. This is the structural source for the matching analysis-timeline and favourites-list entries above. Owed to T559 (phase 5, the retrofit that empties this allowlist).
